title: Conversation History Context
description: Added generateResponseWithHistory() to LLMService that fetches last N interactions from DB and includes them as conversation context in the prompt. Updated all workflows (Buyer, Seller, Partner Agent, Management, Unknown) to use history-aware responses for multi-turn conversational coherence.
features: generateResponseWithHistory() fetches last 10 interactions by default
Interactions reversed to chronological order for context
Graceful fallback to non-history response on error
